title: AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to execute Modification No. 25 to Contract No. PS272680011357 with Bicycle Transit Systems, Inc., DBA…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0672, Contract]
[OPERATIONS, SAFETY, AND CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (6-0):]
AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to execute Modification No. 25 to Contract No. PS272680011357 with Bicycle Transit Systems, Inc., DBA Revolution, to implement and support the grant funded expansion of the Metro Bike Share (MBS) system in the Not-To-Exceed (NTE) amount of $7,550,000, increasing the total contract value from $139,830,029 to $147,380,029.
summary: Authorizes contract modification with Bicycle Transit Systems, Inc. for grant-funded expansion of Metro Bike Share system, adding $7.55 million to the contract value.
